description: Questions an author asked to have asked differently (Phase 2.H, issue #36 item 4). Each case is one unanswered question of an open round and the element it is about. A right rephrase asks about the same element, the same targets and the same mode, from another angle, repeating nothing asked; it invents no story content and keeps the author's own words out of the question unless they are quoted for a challenge.
